name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preselects sharp edges and textures during upscaling, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality without extra compute—critical for our 0.5% target. The trade-off is a heavier ComfyUI load, but we can run it on the secondary GPU to avoid bottlenecking the main pipeline.

name: Torque
text: InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—it’s a texture enhancer, not a facial detail recoverer. The real risk is wasted effort: we’d burn cycles on a tool that can’t touch the core problem, while RealVisXL v1.0’s face model already caps at 0.4% gain. Run a blind A/B test on 50 faces—if InstantX doesn’t beat the baseline by 0.5%, scrap it.
